_JWT_comment: Do NOT set JWT:ValidIssuer here. The Login API is the issuer and stamps JWT:ValidIssuer from ITS appsettings.json (https://UserManagementAPI.techretainer.com); its Development.json overrides only the Secret. This file previously pinned ValidIssuer to http://localhost:7010, and since the Farm API validates with ValidateIssuer=true, EVERY [Authorize] endpoint answered a bare 401 in local dev. Only Secret belongs here - it must match the Login API byte for byte. See DEV_SETUP_AND_KNOWN_ISSUES.md Issue 3.
